title: Scalar tensor-pullback equation on flat K-flat pairs for constructed tensor data
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, p:X→Y a scheme morphism, aX,aY intrinsic tensor models, and P,Q flat-term K-flat fixed-scalar cochain complexes on Y. For the specific uniquely normalized tensor isomorphisms finiteScalarTensorRealization [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-realization], the tensor-pullback square with finiteScalarPullbackComparison and finiteScalarCurriedTensorPullback [def-sf-finite-scalar-pullback-comparison] commutes at the localized pair (Q(P),Q(Q)). This statement has no existential tensor data and asserts the square only on resolving complexes. It uses no projection map.

proof.text: Compare the two ordinary direct images through the scalar unit and the coefficient Hom bijection. The constant-section normalization makes the ordinary inverse mate the associated-module realization of inverse image.

The ordinary tensor comparison in the constructed realization is normalized on pure tensors. Both composites of the ordinary tensor-pullback square send a balanced pure tensor to the tensor of its two inverse-image unit sections. Tensor and sheafification universal properties prove the square. Apply it in each bidegree and use the signed-total coproduct injection equations.

For the given flat-term K-flat pair, localize this chain square. Substitute the constructed tensor-realization normalization and the canonical intrinsic and fixed tensor-pullback representative equations. The derived adjunction Hom bijections identify the inverse mate with the specified finiteScalarPullbackComparison. Cancel the representative and exact-functor factor isomorphisms. No extension to arbitrary derived inputs is made here.

theorem finiteScalarTensorPullback_onRepresentatives
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (proEtaleConstantRing X R))
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y R))
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (_hp : finiteScalarFlatRepresentatives Y R P)
    (_hq : finiteScalarFlatRepresentatives Y R Q) :
    let F := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).leftDerivedFunctor
    let EX := (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X R).functor
    let EY := (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y R).functor
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    let N := DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q
    EX.map (((ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).app M).app N) ≫
        ((finiteScalarTensorRealization X R aX).hom.app (F.obj M)).app (F.obj N) =
      (finiteScalarPullbackComparison R p).inv.app
          (((ProEtale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) Y).obj M).obj N) ≫
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback R p).map
          (((finiteScalarTensorRealization Y R aY).hom.app M).app N) ≫
        ((finiteScalarCurriedTensorPullback R p aX aY).app (EY.obj M)).app (EY.obj N) ≫
        ((curry.obj aX.tensor).map ((finiteScalarPullbackComparison R p).hom.app M)).app _ ≫
        ((curry.obj aX.tensor).obj _).map
          ((finiteScalarPullbackComparison R p).hom.app N)
